items.raw_excerpt: Doctors at Victoria's public hospitals will walk off the job for four hours leaving staffing at weekend levels, as a 14-month bargaining process over pay and conditions continues to grind on.
items.summary_en: Doctors at public hospitals in Victoria, Australia will leave work for four hours. They want a better deal on pay and working conditions after 14 months of talks. Hospitals will run with weekend-level staff during the strike.
items.summary_ko: 호주 빅토리아주 공공병원 의사와 보조 의료진이 4시간 동안 파업에 들어간다. 임금과 근로조건을 둘러싼 협상이 14개월째 답보 상태이기 때문이다. 파업 기간 병원 인력은 주말 수준으로 운영된다.
items.title_en: Doctors and allied health staff to walk off job in Victoria
items.title_ko: 빅토리아주 의사와 보조 의료진, 임금 갈등 속 4시간 파업
items.title_original: Doctors and allied health professionals to walk off job en masse amid pay disputes

items.raw_excerpt: The U.S. dollar was traded at NT$31.895 at 10 a.m. Thursday on the Taipei Foreign Exchange, up NT$0.043 from the previous close.
items.summary_en: The U.S. dollar was traded at NT$31.895 at 10 a.m. Thursday on the Taipei Foreign Exchange. It rose NT$0.043 from the previous close.
items.summary_ko: 목요일 오전 10시 타이베이 외환시장에서 미국 달러화는 NT$31.895에 거래됐다. 직전 종가보다 NT$0.043 올랐다.
items.title_original: U.S. dollar up in Taipei trading

items.raw_excerpt: El jugador tuvo un quiebre con el plantel un día después de la derrota con Estados Unidos y a seis días del amistoso con México.
items.summary_en: Marcelino Núñez left the Chile national team camp after a dispute with the squad. It happened one day after a loss to the United States and six days before a friendly match with Mexico.
items.summary_ko: 마르세리노 누녜스가 팀 동료들과의 갈등 뒤 칠레 대표팀 합숙소를 떠났습니다. 미국전 패배 하루 뒤이자 멕시코와의 평가전 엿새 전의 일입니다.
items.title_en: Chile footballer leaves team camp after argument
items.title_ko: 칠레 축구 선수, 팀 내 갈등으로 대표팀 합숙소 떠나
items.title_original: Casi terminó a los golpes: El motivo de la salida de Marcelino Núñez de la concentración de La Roja

items.raw_excerpt: Tasmanian Education Minister Jo Palmer's office claimed there were no proposals to cut a specialist team that works with teachers. A week later, the team is being cut by a quarter.
items.summary_en: Tasmania's education minister said her office had no plans to cut a special team that helps teachers. One week later, the team is set to lose a quarter of its jobs.
items.summary_ko: 타스마니아 교육부 장관실은 교사들을 돕는 전담팀을 줄일 계획이 없다고 밝혔다. 그런데 일주일 뒤 이 팀 인력의 25%가 감축될 예정이다.
items.title_en: Teacher support team faces job cuts a week after minister's denial
items.title_ko: 장관 부인 후 일주일 만에 교사 지원팀 일자리 감축
items.title_original: Teacher support team faces job cuts a week after minister's denial

items.raw_excerpt: While some BLOs claim that they were pressured to sign the forms, which were submitted in bulk, others refused to sign the forms.
items.summary_en: Booth-level election officers in Belagavi, India say they were pressured to sign forms that were already filled out. The forms target Muslim voters in the area. Some officers refused to sign, but others gave in to the pressure.
items.summary_ko: 인도 벨라가비의 투표소 관리원들은 미리 작성된 유권자 삭제 신청서에 서명하라는 압박을 받았다고 밝혔다. 그 서류는 지역 내 무슬림 유권자를 겨냥한 것으로 알려졌다. 일부는 서명을 거부했지만 다른 직원들은 서명한 것으로 전해졌다.
items.title_en: Filled forms targeting Muslim voters surface in Belagavi; election officers allege pressure to sign
items.title_ko: 벨라가비서 무슬림 유권자 겨냥 사전 작성 서류 발견…선관원들 서명 압박 주장
items.title_original: SIR: Filled Form-7 targeting Muslim voters surface in Belagavi; BLOs allege they were pressured to sign

items.raw_excerpt: Shannon Tan is gunning for a historic Asian Games golf medal for Singapore.
items.summary_en: Shannon Tan shot a six-under 64 to lead the women's individual golf standings after two rounds at the Asian Games. The 22-year-old is two strokes ahead of India's Pranavi Sharath Urs with two rounds left. No Singaporean has ever won an individual Asian Games golf medal.
items.summary_ko: 셰넌 탄이 아시안 게임 여자 개인 골프 2라운드까지 합계 6언더파 64타를 기록하며 선두를 지켰다. 22세 선수는 남은 두 라운드를 앞두고 인도의 프라나비 샤라스 우르스를 2타 차로 앞서고 있다. 지금까지 싱가포르 선수는 아시안 게임 개인 골프 금메달을 획득한 적이 없다.
items.title_en: Singapore golfer Shannon Tan leads by two shots at halfway point of Asian Games golf
items.title_ko: 싱가포르 골퍼 셰넌 탄, 아시안 게임 절반 지점에서 2타 차 선두
items.title_original: Singapore's Shannon Tan holds two-shot lead at halfway mark of Asian Games golf

items.raw_excerpt: Nearly $4 million in funding will go towards setting up collection points for forestry waste that can be turned into biofuel.
items.summary_en: New Zealand will put nearly $4 million into new collection points for forestry waste. The waste will be turned into biofuel. The funding aims to help rural communities recycle wood and plant scraps.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드가 삼림 폐기물 수집 지점을 새로 만드는 데 약 400만 달러를 투입합니다. 수집된 폐기물은 바이오연료로 전환됩니다. 이번 지원은 농촌 지역의 나무와 식물 폐기물 재활용을 돕기 위한 것입니다.
items.title_en: Nearly $4 Million for Forestry Waste Biofuel
items.title_ko: 삼림 폐기물 바이오연료 위해 약 400만 달러 지원
items.title_original: Nearly $4 million announced towards collecting forestry waste to be turned into biofuel
